name: Morin Cloudstalker
summary: Along the eastern road from Bloodhoof Village, Morin Cloudstalker watches over Mulgore. The tauren scout keeps an eye on trade routes and investigates threats to travelers.

sections.title: Watcher on the Southern Trail
sections.body: Morin Cloudstalker watches the trail east toward the Barrens. He scouts the road and guards those traveling through Mulgore. The plains are usually peaceful, but trade routes and shifting territories have brought opportunists and bandits close to the tauren homeland.

sections.title: Investigating the Caravan
sections.body: Morin's scouts attacked and burned a Venture Co. caravan on Stonebull Lake's northern shore. Goblin salvagers appeared near the burned wagons, so he sent adventurers to inspect the surviving supply crates and learn what the Venture Co. had been hauling.

sections.title: Defending Against Venture Co.
sections.body: The Venture Company has established operations in Mulgore, troubling Morin beyond the threat of common brigands. He sends Horde adventurers against its logging and mining outposts, including Supervisor Fizsprocket, to curb the damage to the sacred plains.

faq.q: Where can I find Morin Cloudstalker?
faq.answer: Morin Cloudstalker stands beside the dirt trail east of Bloodhoof Village, on the road toward the Barrens.

faq.q: What is Morin's role in Mulgore?
faq.answer: Morin watches travel through southern Mulgore and organizes defenses against bandits and corporate intruders.

faq.q: Why is Morin investigating the ruined caravan?
faq.answer: Morin's scouts attacked and burned a Venture Co. caravan near Stonebull Lake. After goblin salvagers appeared at the wreckage, he asked adventurers to inspect the surviving crates and find out what the Venture Co. was moving.

faq.q: Why does Morin want the Venture Company stopped?
faq.answer: The Venture Company is stripping Mulgore's natural resources with machinery and deforestation. Morin wants its overseers, including Supervisor Fizsprocket, stopped.
Morin acts on behalf of Bloodhoof Village's elders and chieftains, and the wider tauren leadership across Mulgore.

faq.q: Does Morin offer quests to Alliance players?
faq.answer: No. Morin is loyal to the Horde and interacts only with Horde adventurers.

angles.text: As a tauren traveling out from Bloodhoof Village, you can see Morin guarding your homeland against bandits and corporate defilers.
Morin gives Horde champions an early chance to protect the supplies and sacred lands of their new tauren allies.
